name: Matzalantli
description: A massive gilded city of stepped stone buildings above and below an underground freshwater ocean.

description_citations.text: "River Heralds". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nicanzil summons the Sun Empire group to the convocation.
timeline.quote: The convocation begins

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The Sun Empire party reaches the top of the building facing the golden door and meets the vampires, provoking hostility.
timeline.quote: The other warriors mirrored her disgust, some reaching for weapons.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Pashona questions Quint and Huatli about their intentions.
timeline.quote: Who are you, stranger?

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Inti and Caparocti call for the vampires to be imprisoned or killed, and Pashona threatens to return them to the sea.
timeline.quote: These invaders should be imprisoned

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Bartolomé warns that Torrezon and Queen Miralda would be displeased if the Legion is harmed.
timeline.quote: Torrezon as well. Queen Miralda would be most displeased.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Huatli proposes that the Sun Empire and River Heralds cooperate to open the door.
timeline.quote: Shaper, your people and mine seek to open this door. I propose we work together.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Huatli appeals to shared struggle against the Phyrexians to ease tensions over Orazca and the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: We all fought against the Phyrexians to defend our homes.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Bartolomé says Queen Miralda might negotiate, and Vito silences him until Pashona allows the work to proceed.
timeline.quote: Queen Miralda might be open to such negotiations, depending on what we find.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Quint summons Abuelo's Echo using the poncho.
timeline.quote: He pulled the poncho from his pack and once again cast the spell to summon Abuelo.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Abuelo recognizes Matzalantli and says they must warn the Oltec about the Mycotyrant.
timeline.quote: We must get inside and warn the Oltec about the Mycotyrant.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Abuelo uses Abuela's khipu to find the key to the golden door.
timeline.quote: Here! The golden door.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Huatli recognizes the pattern as a key, arranges the cosmium beads, and the door unseals and swings open.
timeline.quote: Light burst through a crack at the seam of the now unsealed portal, which swung open with a rush of surprisingly cold, fresh air.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Beyond the door, the party reaches a well-like opening showing a circle of sky deep underground.
timeline.quote: They stood before a circle of sky dotted with clouds.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Figures above the well notice that the seal has been opened and call for Anim Pakal.
timeline.quote: Someone has opened the seal.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 4" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Malcolm and Breeches head through the golden door to warn the Core.
timeline.quote: Our people beyond the golden door must be warned that it is closer than they knew.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Wayta sees a siren fleeing from the door and a flood of fungal creatures behind him.
timeline.quote: A rush of greenish blackness poured through the portal behind him.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: The Oltec seal the Core with Matzalantli, cutting off travel between surface and depths.
timeline.quote: the Oltec sealed the Core using Matzalantli

citation.work: Caverns of Ixalan
citation.text: "Caverns of Ixalan", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the death of the Deeproot Tree, Shaper Pashona rediscovers Matzalantli and thousands of merfolk gather in Topizielo to open it.
timeline.quote: After the death of the Deeproot Tree, Shaper Pashona rediscovered Matzalanti

citation.work: Caverns of Ixalan
citation.text: "Caverns of Ixalan", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Merfolk bands hold the largest assembly in Ixalan's history to open the door.
timeline.quote: thousands of merfolk gathered in Topizielo for a convocation to open the door

citation.work: Caverns of Ixalan
citation.text: "Caverns of Ixalan", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Queen's Bay Company breaches Matzalantli, reawakening the plane's lost history.
timeline.quote: expeditions like the Queen's Bay Company braved the deep once more, breaching Matzalantli

citation.work: Caverns of Ixalan
citation.text: "Caverns of Ixalan", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Shaper Pashona rediscovers Matzalantli.
timeline.quote: Shaper Pashona rediscovered Matzalantli

citation.work: River Heralds
citation.text: "River Heralds", section "Matzalantli". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tishana summons all merfolk to a tribal congress, the largest assembly of merfolk bands in Ixalan's history.
timeline.quote: summoned all merfolk who could hear her to the tribal congress so that they could decide together the fate of the plane

citation.work: River Heralds
citation.text: "River Heralds", section "Matzalantli". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
